title: agent/1 — the discovery document at /.well-known/agent
description: Structural schema for agent/1. Necessary but not sufficient: the cross-field rules (every endpoint, the handshake and the frontdoor sit on the document's domain or a subdomain of it — the same-domain rule of vendor-domain.mjs, never a registrable-domain guess; a priced capability requires a payment section; policies.humanApprovalFor names declared capabilities; capability ids are unique; auth and payment methods are unique) are enforced by validate() in vendor-agent.mjs. Keys prefixed x- are carried and never checked, at every level — the format's one extension convention.

domain.description: The lowercase hostname this document speaks for. No scheme, no path, no port. Every endpoint host must be this domain or a subdomain of it.

org.description: The organisation's id in the estate id grammar: org/<slug>.

updated.description: ISO date the document was last changed.

capabilities.description: What an agent may DO here. Ids are unique (cross-field rule).

auth.description: Authentication methods accepted. Required so that silence never reads as open; `none` is spelled out.

payment.description: Payment methods accepted. Required when any capability carries a price (cross-field rule).

handshake.description: The organisation's own flashyos/1 handshake, if it publishes one. Its host is this document's domain or a subdomain of it (cross-field rule).

frontdoor.description: The organisation's own frontdoor/1 door, if it publishes one. Its host is this document's domain or a subdomain of it (cross-field rule).

httpsUrl.description: An https URL with a DNS hostname. validate() additionally refuses userinfo and explicit ports.

methodToken.description: A token, optionally naming a versioned standard such as delegation/1.

amount.description: Whole minor units of the currency: 2500 is 25.00 in a two-decimal currency. Never a float, never a string.

per.description: The unit priced: request, booking, minute.

name.description: A person, not a role or a department.

email.description: A mailbox a human reads. The template placeholder is refused.

id.description: A lowercase verb-like token: quote, book, refund. Departments are refused by name.

endpoint.description: Where the action lives. https, on this document's domain or a subdomain of it.

schema.description: The request/response schema for this endpoint.

jurisdictions.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes of the jurisdictions served.

humanApprovalAtOrAbove.description: Above this amount a human on the serving side approves before execution.

humanApprovalFor.description: Capability ids that always require human approval. Each must be declared (cross-field rule).
